body:
Recent username: Togglecontrol
Reason Why I was Banned: Forcefield/Aura kill
Why Should I get un-banned from the Server:
Well, So, I have been helping out the community for more than 3 months, Trying to keep chat appropiate, Telling people to /report and not accusate of Hacks, Trying to keep a Calm  Atmoshphere, etc. I have been doing that for, As I said Before, More than 3 months, and that took time of me, but I always thought that it wasn´t time Wasted, I always thought that It was A useful time.

So, Yes, I was HeadTwitching. That doesn´t mean that I was hacking of Any sourt, And That I killed 4-5 people in a row didn´t actually mean that much, Just that I was clicking fast.

If there is any doubt about me AutoClicking or Hacking, Here there is a video in which I Click. I do 8,9 clicks per second.
http://youtu.be/1V_oZH74cjk


Also, I am in a Pretty good Faction and in a pretty good MCSG clan, So I am quite experienced on PvP.

I have played 4 Kohi Factions map, Fought against people like Stimpay, And Why would I hack in the end? It  would´we been 3 months of Helping out wasted.
Also, It wasn´t because of a team, Because i am already on Liquidators, A, IMO, Pretty good team.
https://avicus.net/teams/28

Also, At the time of the ban, I was with Awesomerp and Snowy on Teamspeak, With Mic on, And I was cliking, and If I am correct, With Kill aura you do not have to click
